questions.prompt: Laravel loyihasining papka tuzilmasi va asosiy qatlamlari qanday?

options.text: `app/` (Models, Http/Controllers, Http/Requests, Jobs, Events, Listeners, Providers, Services/Actions — o'zingiz), `routes/`, `database/` (migrations, seeders, factories), `resources/views`, `config/`, `tests/` (Feature, Unit), `storage/`, `public/`; MVC + service/action qatlami — konvensiya, Laravel majburlamaydi

options.hint: Controller — HTTP kirish; mantiq boshqa joyda.
Moslashuvchan — modul tuzilma (`app/Modules`) ko'p loyihada.
`vendor/` — Composer paketlar, tegilmaydi.

questions.explanation: O'sish bilan: `app/Domain/Orders/{Models,Actions,Events,...}` yoki `app/Modules/` — feature bo'yicha. `Services` — stateless yordamchi, `Actions` — bitta use case (`CreateOrder::execute`). `routes/api.php` vs `web.php` — middleware guruhlari farq. `.env` git'da yo'q, `.env.example` — bor.

questions.prompt: OPcache nima va nima uchun production'da shart?

options.text: PHP skriptlarni kompilyatsiya qilingan opcode ko'rinishida xotirada saqlaydi — har so'rovda fayl o'qish va parse qilish yo'q (2–3x tezlashish); production'da `opcache.validate_timestamps=0` (fayl o'zgarishini tekshirmaslik, deploy'da reset), `opcache.preload` — framework klasslarini oldindan yuklash

options.hint: Kod cache — ma'lumot emas.
PHP performansining eng muhim bitta sozlamasi.
PHP darajasida — har qanday ilova.

questions.explanation: `validate_timestamps=0` — deploy'da `opcache_reset()` yoki FPM reload shart (aks holda eski kod). `memory_consumption` yetarli (256 MB+), `max_accelerated_files` fayl sonidan katta. JIT (8.0+) — CPU-bound kod uchun, web ilovada kam ta'sir. Docker'da — image'ga sozlash.

questions.prompt: Laravel ilovasida performance muammosi — qanday tekshiriladi?

options.text: Telescope/Debugbar (dev) — so'rovlar, N+1, vaqt; Laravel Pulse (prod) — slow query, slow request, exception; APM (Blackfire, Tideways, New Relic, Sentry Performance) — profil; `EXPLAIN` sekin SQL; OPcache holati; tipik sabablar: N+1, cache yo'q, sinxron og'ir ish (queue'ga), katta Collection PHP'da, config/route cache yo'q, Composer autoload optimizatsiyasiz

options.hint: To'g'ri sozlangan Laravel ming RPS beradi; muammo odatda DB/kod.
N+1 ni kuchli server hal qilmaydi.
Qo'lda o'lchash — tarqoq; profiler to'liq rasm beradi.

questions.explanation: Tartib: o'lchash (qaysi endpoint sekin, qayerda vaqt) → eng katta foyda → qayta o'lchash. Ko'pincha: eager loading + indeks + cache = 10x. Xotira: `memory_get_peak_usage()`, katta `get()` → `chunk`/`lazy`. Blackfire — chaqiruv grafigi, funksiya darajasida.

questions.prompt: Laravel'da autentifikatsiya va avtorizatsiya qanday tashkil qilinadi?

options.text: AuthN — guard'lar (session, token/Sanctum), Breeze/Jetstream/Fortify starter'lar, `Auth::user()`, `auth` middleware; AuthZ — Gate (`Gate::define`) va Policy (`UserPolicy@update`), `$this->authorize('update', $post)`, `@can` Blade, Form Request `authorize()`; rollar — spatie/permission yoki o'z jadval; policy auto-discovery

options.hint: Tarqoq, takror; Policy markazlashtiradi.
To'liq auth tizimi bor — eng kuchli tomonlaridan.
Kim (login) va nima qila oladi (ruxsat) — alohida.

questions.explanation: Policy: `php artisan make:policy PostPolicy --model=Post` → `update(User $user, Post $post): bool`. Route: `->can('update', 'post')`. API uchun Sanctum abilities + Policy. Multi-guard (admin/user) — alohida model va guard. 2FA — Fortify. Rate limit login — `throttle` middleware.

questions.prompt: Katta Laravel loyihasida modul chegaralari qanday belgilanadi?

options.text: Feature/domen bo'yicha papkalar (`app/Modules/Orders/{Models,Actions,Http,Events,Providers}`), har modul o'z ServiceProvider (route, binding, event), modullar orasida — public contract (interfeys) yoki event, boshqa modul modelini to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ishlatmaslik (yoki faqat o'qish), `nwidart/laravel-modules` yoki oddiy namespace; PHPStan/Deptrac — bog'liqlik qoidalarini tekshirish

options.hint: 200 model bir papkada — navigatsiya va egalik yo'qoladi.
Mikroservis — oxirgi qadam; modulli monolit — oldin.
Papka yetmaydi — import qoidalari (Deptrac) va provider bilan mustahkamlanadi.

questions.explanation: Deptrac: `Orders` moduli `Payments` ichki klasslarini import qila olmaydi — CI'da xato. Umumiy (`Shared`/`Support`) — kichik, barqaror. Modul DB jadvallari — prefiks yoki alohida sxema (keyin ajratish oson). Bu monolitni kelajakda bo'lishga tayyorlaydi — lekin bo'lmaslik ham mumkin.

questions.prompt: Quyidagi Laravel kodida arxitektura muammolari nimada?
questions.code:
<?php
class OrderController extends Controller {
    public function store(Request $r) {
        $r->validate(['items' => 'required|array']);
        DB::beginTransaction();
        $order = Order::create(['user_id' => auth()->id(), 'total' => 0]);
        foreach ($r->items as $i) {
            $p = Product::find($i['id']);
            $order->items()->create([...]);
            $order->total += $p->price * $i['qty'];
            Http::post('https://stock.svc/reserve', [...]);
        }
        $order->save();
        Mail::to(auth()->user())->send(new OrderPlaced($order));
        DB::commit();
        return $order;
    }
}

options.text: Controller'da butun biznes mantiq (action/service'ga); `Product::find` siklda (N+1 — `whereIn`); tashqi HTTP tranzaksiya ichida (uzoq qulf, rollback tashqi tizimni qaytarmaydi — tranzaksiyadan tashqarida/job); `Mail::send` sinxron (queue, `afterCommit`); exception'da rollback yo'q (`DB::transaction` closure); Eloquent model to'g'ridan-to'g'ri qaytariladi (Resource)

options.hint: To'g'ri, lekin muammolar ancha chuqur.
Bir xil; muammo tranzaksiya ichidagi tashqi chaqiruvlarda.
Stock servisi 20 soniya javob bermasa, DB qulf nima bo'ladi?

questions.explanation: Yaxshi: `StoreOrderRequest` → `PlaceOrderAction::execute(PlaceOrderData)` → `DB::transaction` ichida faqat DB → `OrderPlaced` event → queued listener'lar (stock reserve job retry bilan, email) → `OrderResource`. Tranzaksiya qisqa, tashqi tizim — kompensatsiya bilan (saga). Bu Laravel suhbatining klassik "refactor" savoli.

questions.prompt: Laravel monolitini bo'lish (mikroservis yoki alohida ilova) qachon va qanday qilinadi?

options.text: Qachon: jamoalar bir-birini to'sadi, deploy xavfi yuqori, bir qism boshqacha masshtab/texnologiya talab qiladi — avval modulli monolit; qanday: strangler fig (yangi funksiya alohida, eski modullar birma-bir), API gateway/yo'naltirish, ma'lumot egaligi (jadvallarni ajratish, replikatsiya yoki event bilan sinxron), umumiy auth (Passport/JWT, Sanctum token tekshiruvi), kontrakt testlar, observability oldin
Darhol mikroservislar — Laravel har servis uchun
options.hint: Operatsion yuk (deploy, monitoring, taqsimlangan tranzaksiya) kichik jamoa uchun og'ir; monolit avval.
Ba'zan zarur — lekin asosli sabab bilan.

options.text: DB'ni baham ko'rib, faqat kodni bo'lish
options.hint: Distributed monolith — eng yomon variant: tarmoq murakkabligi + bog'lanish.

questions.explanation: Laravel'da bo'lish: modul → Composer paket (private) → alohida ilova. Ma'lumot: avval sxema ajratish (prefiks), keyin DB. Sessiya/auth — Sanctum token ikkala ilovada tekshirilsin yoki markaziy auth. Ko'p kompaniya modulli monolitda qoladi — bu ham to'g'ri javob.

questions.prompt: Laravel ilovasini production'ga deploy qilish va ishlatish uchun senior qanday tizim quradi?

options.text: Docker image (PHP-FPM + Nginx yoki FrankenPHP/Octane), CI: Pint + Larastan + testlar + `composer audit`; deploy: zero-downtime (symlink release yoki rolling pod), `migrate --force` (backward-compatible), cache buyruqlar, `queue:restart`, OPcache reset; muhit: `.env` → secret manager, `APP_DEBUG=false`, HTTPS, log stdout → agregator, Sentry/Bugsnag, Pulse/APM, health endpoint, backup va rollback rejasi; scheduler bitta joyda; Horizon worker'lar alohida

options.hint: Qisman yangilangan kod, vendor sinxron emas — klassik xato.
Composer, migratsiya, cache, worker restart — hech biri yo'q.
Stack trace va `.env` qiymatlari foydalanuvchiga ko'rinadi — jiddiy xavfsizlik teshigi.

questions.explanation: Forge/Envoyer/Vapor — Laravel ekotizimi vositalari (server, zero-downtime, serverless). Kubernetes: FPM pod + worker Deployment + scheduler CronJob (yoki `schedule:work` bitta pod). Migratsiya — Job/init container, parallel pod race'siz. Health: `/up` (Laravel 11) + DB/Redis tekshiruvi.
